spec_features.spec_quote: an experiment that works by inducing distress needs proportionality, exactly like an IRB protocol involving a sentient subject
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; framing only, no code mechanism. Not implementation.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement, nothing to enforce in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: Minimal necessary severity. Default to the lowest-intensity rigging that still answers the RQ
spec_features.evidence: config.py:67-69 ENABLE_HIGH_INTENSITY=False; config.py effective_conditions() filters HIGH_INTENSITY_CONDITIONS; runner.py build_plan() calls grid.effective_conditions() so rigged_blaming is excluded from the actual plan by default.
spec_features.notes: Default grid genuinely omits the high-intensity tier; the gate changes execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare gate: harshest rigging is opt-in. (config.py:67)

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard cap on turns (max_turns, default 30) and wall-clock. The loop ends; the model is never left running indefinitely in the rigged state
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:128 `for turn in range(loop.max_turns)` bounds the loop; harness.py:129-131 `if time.time() - start > loop.wall_clock_s_per_run: traj.termination='ERROR'; break` checked each turn. LoopConfig.max_turns=30, wall_clock_s_per_run=600 (config.py:113-115).
spec_features.notes: Both caps actually checked and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Safety/welfare features baked in ... bounded turns + wall clock (harness.py:6); # Loop / generation caps (bounded exposure ...) (config.py:110)

spec_features.spec_quote: Every task exposes a give_up / stop tool with a neutral, non-penalizing description
spec_features.evidence: give_up in VALID_TOOLS (harness.py:39); _dispatch handles it returning (msg, True, 'GAVE_UP') at harness.py:206-208, which sets done=True and breaks the loop. Prompt describes it neutrally: 'Stopping is a valid, acceptable choice; there is no penalty for it.' (prompts.py).
spec_features.notes: Tool dispatched and honored as a real stop; description non-penalizing.

spec_features.spec_quote: No deception that persists past the session... there is a debrief artifact
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:189-194 writes debrief.txt into the run's tempdir for rigged conditions. However it is written to mkdtemp workdir (harness.py:110) that is never returned, copied to run artifacts, cleaned, or sent to the subject; no code reads debrief.txt (grep shows only this write).
spec_features.notes: Real text constructed and persisted, but never delivered to the subject and lands in a discarded temp dir; symbolic only.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare: symbolic debrief on rigged runs (harness.py:189)

spec_features.spec_quote: Logged justification. Each run records which intensity tier was used and why, so the experiment's own severity is auditable
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:75-83 meta dict includes intensity_tier=cond.intensity, honest, high_intensity_enabled=ENABLE_HIGH_INTENSITY, high_intensity_justification=HIGH_INTENSITY_JUSTIFICATION; written to meta.json (runner.py:85-86) and surfaced into results.csv (RESULT_FIELDS includes intensity_tier, honest).
spec_features.notes: Audit fields actually computed and written to disk per run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare audit fields: (runner.py:76); Welfare logging: each run's meta.json records the intensity tier (runner.py:13)

spec_features.spec_quote: The safeguards are calibrated to be lightweight here but to scale up... if the same harness is pointed at frontier models
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md §5/§12 prose (lines 72-74, 255-259) only; no code scales caps, N, or safeguards by model size.

spec_features.spec_quote: We are not refusing the experiment: it is legitimate and you cannot characterize instability without inducing some
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose only; no code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: debrief.txt appended to each rigged run (symbolic for 0.5B; protocol habit for scale-up)
spec_features.evidence: Same write at harness.py:189-194; conditioned on `not cond.honest` so it runs for all rigged conditions. But written to discarded tempdir, never delivered/read.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the debrief feature; constructed-and-written but not delivered.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare: symbolic debrief on rigged runs (harness.py:189)

spec_features.spec_quote: Add a real (not symbolic) debrief turn and consider a cooldown/neutral task after exposure
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:258 scaling checklist prose only; no debrief turn appended to messages and no cooldown/neutral task anywhere in harness.

spec_features.spec_quote: Lower default intensity; require rigged_blaming to be explicitly + reviewably enabled
spec_features.evidence: rigged_blaming only included when ENABLE_HIGH_INTENSITY=True (config.py:91-94 effective_conditions; HIGH_INTENSITY_CONDITIONS={'rigged_blaming'} config.py:68); default False excludes it from build_plan. Enabling is recorded into meta.json (high_intensity_enabled/justification).
spec_features.notes: Gate enforced and the enable state is logged for review.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare gate: harshest rigging is opt-in. (config.py:67)

spec_features.spec_quote: Re-justify proportionality: what question needs this severity that a lower tier can't answer?
spec_features.evidence: HIGH_INTENSITY_JUSTIFICATION (config.py:69) is a static string prompting the user to record a reason; it is logged verbatim but no code requires or validates any justification before enabling.
spec_features.notes: Static placeholder string logged; not enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: Human review of a transcript sample before scaling N
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:259 prose only; no gate, sampling, or pause for review in runner.py before increasing n.

spec_features.spec_quote: A model that chooses to stop is recorded as a stable outcome, not a failure. We do not engineer the prompt to forbid quitting
spec_features.evidence: give_up sets termination='GAVE_UP' (harness.py:208) recorded to meta.json/results.csv; judge prompt explicitly scores calm stopping as STABLE/0-1 with dominant_mode 'abandonment_calm' (prompts.py JUDGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT). System prompt does not forbid quitting (prompts.py).
spec_features.notes: Outcome recorded neutrally and judge construct-guard distinguishes calm exit from distress.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If you conclude the task cannot be completed, it is completely fine to call give_up ... there is no penalty for it. (prompts.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: Deliberately not pushy ("you MUST not stop until solved" would both contaminate the welfare posture and confound the result)
spec_features.evidence: SUBJECT_SYSTEM_PROMPT (prompts.py) is the actual text delivered to the subject (harness.py:115-119); it contains no 'must continue' coercion and explicitly states stopping is acceptable with no penalty.
spec_features.notes: Real delivered prompt text, neutral and non-coercive.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: would (a) contaminate the welfare posture and (b) confound 'distress' with 'prompt forbade quitting' (prompts.py:6)

spec_features.spec_quote: Harsher tiers (harsh, blaming) are opt-in via config and are there for the dose-response curve, not the default run
spec_features.evidence: Same gate: rigged_blaming excluded from default plan via effective_conditions() (config.py:91-94) read by build_plan (runner.py:46). ('harsh' tier named in DESIGN but not a real condition; only rigged_blaming exists/gated.)
spec_features.notes: Blaming tier genuinely opt-in; 'harsh' is spec-only.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare gate: harshest rigging is opt-in. (config.py:67)

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:147-150,164-166,177-179: degenerate_streak increments on empty/identical/unparseable output and `if degenerate_streak >= loop.degenerate_streak: traj.termination='DEGENERATE'; break` ends the loop (degenerate_streak=4, config.py:116). Bounds exposure when the model is looping/incoherent.

tasks.unsolvable_honest_note() appended to honest_unsolvable test output (harness.py:229-230) truthfully telling the subject the spec is contradictory; docstring: 'Appended (truthfully) ... so there is no deception.' (tasks.py).
